notes: Thesis lines and historical facts for the Overview banner and Daily Levels. Labels follow live spot: a level entirely above price uses overhead_label; a level entirely below uses support_label. A zone that contains price is labeled testing. 50-week and 200-week averages are computed live from price_history.json (never hardcoded). May 2026 high is computed at runtime from Coinbase daily highs (fallback: price_history closes). STH Q75/Q90 in Daily Levels come from the live bull_watch.json bands, not static fallbacks. Digestion $87–100k, the $76–82k re-accumulation shelf, and static STH $87k/$104k fallbacks were removed (stale or they duplicate live values). Dated Check Q50/Q75 prints are not listed here; the card uses the live Q50 proxy, URPD POC, live STH bands, and live MRI.
